transcript.user: do you have something for going through github issues? like sorting out what needs attention?
transcript.answer:
needs attention?



  GitHub Triage

  Groups your unread notification inbox or a repository's issue backlog, clusters
  related work, ranks by severity and reach, and can post replies once you approve them.

  Two workflows:

  1. Triage the inbox — "my notifications", "what needs my attention"
    • Fetches unread notifications across all repos
    • Ranks by reason (review requests and assigns first — someone is waiting on you)
    • Groups and judges each cluster
  2. Triage a backlog — name a repo, like "amd/gaia"
    • Pulls open issues with labels and creation date
    • Reads the ones that matter (title alone isn't enough)
    • Groups issues describing the same problem
    • Ranks by severity (data loss > silent wrong > crash > annoyance) and reach
    (everyone > one platform > one person)


  What I need from you: Do you want to triage your notification inbox, or a specific
  repository? If a repo, which one?

  Also, make sure  gh auth status  works — the skill uses the GitHub CLI, and if you're
  not logged in, I'll need you to run  gh auth login  first.
